definition: Codex Cloud is the cloud-hosted version of Codex, OpenAI's coding assistant, announced at DevDay 2026. Coding tasks now run on hosted machines instead of your computer: you can start a task on your phone, close your laptop, and the work keeps running in the cloud. Teams get reusable development environments — a shared, pre-approved setup with the right permissions — so a task starts immediately instead of being rebuilt per developer. Around it came a refreshed Codex CLI (command-line interface, the text-based way developers talk to tools), a code-review surface in the ChatGPT desktop app, and Codex Security Cloud, which scans repositories for vulnerabilities on a schedule and drafts fixes.

edges.label: agentic coding, packaged
edges.note: Codex Cloud is an agentic system specialized for software work: goal in, tested code out.

edges.label: runs on the managed harness
edges.note: It uses the same managed agent infrastructure OpenAI offers developers through the Agents API.

edges.label: pre-approved permissions
edges.note: Reusable environments come with approved settings — the permissions question is answered up front, not per task.

example.body: Your team's app has a login bug. At 6pm a developer tells Codex: “find and fix the login bug, run the tests.” The developer closes the laptop and goes to dinner. In the cloud, Codex reproduces the bug, patches it, and runs the test suite — and the security scan flags a second vulnerability in the same file, with a prepared fix. By morning there are two pull requests waiting for human review, each with a findings dashboard. The code changed on machines nobody on the team could see.
example.title: The fix that landed overnight

footnotes.body: Codex Cloud access spans Plus, Pro, Business, Healthcare, Education, and Enterprise plans; Codex Security Cloud is on Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu. A refreshed Codex CLI adds voice steering. One deadline from the keynote: Agent Builder, the workflow builder launched at DevDay 2025, loses access on November 30, 2026, with migration to the Agents SDK (software development kit) and Workspace Agents.
footnotes.label: Plans and one deadline

name: Codex Cloud
tagline: OpenAI's coding agent, moved fully into the cloud — close your laptop and the task keeps running.
whyItMatters: Coding assistants stop being a tab in your editor and become workers you dispatch. For a non-technical person, the closest analogy is hiring a developer who doesn't need your computer to be on. The flip side: code now changes on machines you can't see — which is exactly why the security scanning and pre-approved permissions shipped alongside.
